g.text: Down Home Creole · Phase 1 · P1-412 Bench spindle capper (built in house) · rev B
SS 304 (ASTM A240 plate / A554 tube / A276 bar)
No product contact (caps on): #4 brushed or bead blast; passivate ASTM A967
UNLESS NOTED: LINEAR ±0.5 [±.02] · HOLES +0.2/-0 · ANGLES ±0.5° · MACHINED X.X ±0.1, X.XX ±0.05 · THIRD-ANGLE PROJECTION · BREAK EDGES 0.5 · ASME Y14.5
CBORE Ø6.5 x 3.5 FROM THE REAR

svg.text: shelf top / motor bore axis to B
1. Weld W1-W3 in a fixture; then machine: face B (block face) flat 0.02, drill/cbore the 4 block
holes, then bore the motor pilot Ø30 H8 ⊥ 0.05 to B at 73.6 ±0.05 from B.
2. Shelf top flat 0.1 under the motor face. Lug hole Ø8.2 square to B.
3. Mass of the carriage with motor, clutch, chuck and guard ≈ 11.8 kg (116 N); gas spring 200 N
lifts it with ≈ 85 N to spare.
